Kubernetes startup, readiness and liveness probes of the simulator cannot authenticate. The endpoints return only a status word, no data, and are excluded from OpenAPI; every other simulator endpoint requires authorization and the simulator refuses to start in k8s-prd.

Sign-in is how a caller obtains a token, so it cannot require one (ADR-0026). It is limited to 10 attempts a minute per client address (auth rate limit policy), locks an account after 10 consecutive failures for 15 minutes, answers every failure with the same 401 body after a full PBKDF2 check, never caches its response and returns nothing but the token on success.

Refresh is authenticated by the HttpOnly __Secure-ariva_rt cookie (ADR-0026), not by a bearer token, because the access token it replaces may already have expired. It refuses a request without X-Ariva-Csrf: 1 or without an allow-listed Origin (CWE-352), shares the 10 a minute auth rate limit, rotates the token on every use and revokes the whole family on reuse.
